posts.author: Cristiano_Perrucci
posts.content_md:
Hi all,

I'm posting a couple of pictures of my latest works with homebrew MBDCG. 

H1 is a standard Denisyuk, H2 is a Denisuyk of the real image of H1. Unfortunally the digital camera image cannot record the doll head between the glass plate and the observer.

![Image](http://digilander.iol.it/crispers/doll_h1.jpg)

H1: Denisyuk of a doll

![Image](http://digilander.iol.it/crispers/doll_h2.jpg)

H2: Hologram of the real image of H1

A really rough result, but a lot of satisfaction for me!

Cheers,

Cristiano -Genoa, IT-

posts.author: Joe Farina
posts.content_md:
Nice work. I'm sure you will continue to make rapid progress with MBDCG.

I'm a bit curious about the hair on the doll. It looks like the individual strands of hair may have come out nicely in the hologram, which is interesting if you used 5 minute exposures on MBDCG. Did you see any signs of object movement?
